digest: Investigation of a single failed VPN login for user m.alvarez followed by a successful MFA-confirmed login from the same device and IP address. Evidence suggests a benign user error (mistyped password).

evidence_findings.title: Single Failed VPN Authentication
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: A VPN authentication failure was recorded for user 'm.alvarez' from IP address '198.51.100.24' at 08:03Z. This was attributed to a mistyped password.
evidence_findings.conclusion: This event is consistent with a user error rather than a malicious attempt.

evidence_findings.title: Successful MFA-Confirmed VPN Login
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: One minute after the failed attempt, user 'm.alvarez' successfully logged into the VPN from the same IP address '198.51.100.24' at 08:04Z. This login was MFA-confirmed and originated from the user's registered laptop and usual home address.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The immediate successful login with MFA from a known device and location strongly indicates a legitimate user activity following a minor error.

evidence_findings.title: No Prior Authentication Failures
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: There were no other authentication failures for the 'm.alvarez' account in the preceding 30 days.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The absence of a pattern of failed logins further supports the conclusion of an isolated user error.

attack_timeline.attack_behavior: VPN authentication failure for m.alvarez (mistyped password)
Successful MFA-confirmed VPN login for m.alvarez
